title: Hero word cycle: slot roll, typed, wheel-stepped
summary: One slot in a fixed headline cycles a word list three ways: timed reel roll (`back.out` overshoot, 900 ms rest), typed and erased per character, or stepped by the first wheel inputs at `scrollY 0` before the page moves; width held by one grid cell so the line never reflows, `aria-hidden` slot with an `aria-live="off"` label, first word still under reduced motion
variants: timed slot roll: next word up from below with a back.out overshoot, 900 ms rest (this, default)
typed and erased per character: 115 ms in, 58 ms out, 2.2 s hold, 400 ms gap
wheel-stepped: the first wheel inputs at the top step the word before the page scrolls
